finding: Company-page snapshots preserve MarketWatch news-feed records as explicit local publication time + date + source, including BusinessWire - BZX. This is a genuinely new timestamp-bearing archive family suitable for bulk G1 discovery when a target release row is present.
admissibility: A target-specific exact-title row with explicit time/date and BusinessWire or PR Newswire source may be used as timestamp-preserving public-mirror evidence after issuer/release identity matching and chronology checks. Same-company later precedents, unrelated rows, scheduled release notices, conference-call times, and inferred timestamps remain non-admissible.
